attacks.claim: The migration is not a rename. It adds a new empty `private_notes` column and then drops `notes`, so every existing user note is destroyed on deploy. The PR says notes are irrecoverable elsewhere, so this is permanent data loss. The down migration cannot restore the data either.
attacks.evidence: Artifact says "Pure rename, no data change", but 0087_private_notes.up.sql contains: "ALTER TABLE user_recipes ADD COLUMN private_notes text; ALTER TABLE user_recipes DROP COLUMN notes;". Migrations run automatically on merge to main. ABSENT: any UPDATE copying notes into private_notes, or a use of RENAME COLUMN.
